dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Apr 10 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000q519](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000q519) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Apr 10 2025 55km SE of Inahele. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -6.2643 longitude 151.4167. It impacted 848 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
